title: Check nested delimiters
prompt: Return true if (), [], and {} are properly matched and nested. Ignore all other characters. Empty input is balanced. A closing bracket must match the most recent unmatched opening bracket.

tests.label: Nested types
tests.hint: Treat the vector as a last-in, first-out stack.

tests.label: Wrong nesting
tests.hint: Matching counts alone cannot prove nesting.

tests.label: Unclosed opening
tests.hint: The stack must be empty after the loop.

hints: A vector can act as a stack with push_back, back, and pop_back.
Each closing bracket removes exactly one matching opening bracket.
explanation: The stack represents unfinished nesting. Its top is the only opening bracket that a new closing bracket is allowed to match.
